I didn't change anything, because the four files in `src/services/` already pass the project's format rules.

**What I checked:** I tried to run the formatter (`node scripts/lint.js --fix`) on the four service files, but the command needs approval this session can't give. Instead I checked the files directly for what that script enforces: no tab indentation, no trailing whitespace, and a single newline at the end of the file. `auth-service.js`, `order-service.js`, `payment-service.js` and `user-service.js` all pass, so running the formatter wouldn't change them. If you want to confirm, `npm run lint` should report them clean.

**What else "tidy up" could mean:** the only other cleanup I can see is that every service still uses callback-style `query`/`update` calls. Each file has a comment saying it's due to move to a repository class in Chapter 5. That changes behaviour rather than formatting, so I didn't do it without asking. If that's what you meant, I can migrate the modules one at a time with their tests. `payment-service.js` would need a new `PaymentRepository`, since none exists yet.
